data.action: 小口品尝草莓芭菲，并用勺子把最甜的草莓递给你；背部的小翅膀开心拍打
data.camera: close two-shot, shallow depth of field
data.description: 谁也想不到，令不良学生闻风丧胆的风纪委员长私底下其实超喜欢甜食。在隐蔽的咖啡店角落，日奈坐在你对面，小口品尝着草莓芭菲，背部的小翅膀开心地微微拍打——「……老师，这可是绝对机密，绝对不准告诉风纪委员会的其他人哦！作为封口费……分你一颗最甜的草莓。」
data.promptProse: In the cafe booth, Hina holds out a spoon with a strawberry to the teacher seated across from her. Her silver-purple hair and small raised wings catch the warm light. The teacher's cropped black hair and sand-colored knit overshirt remain visible in the near profile while the cafe beyond the booth falls softly out of focus.
data.title: 空崎日奈 · 甜品店里的私语
data.animaCaption: Silver-haired Hina leans over the parfait and offers a strawberry on her spoon. Across the table, the teacher with cropped black hair and a sand-colored knit overshirt turns toward it in profile.
